title: Syzygium aromaticum Extract Mitigates Doxorubicin-Induced Hepatotoxicity in Male Rats.
authors: Alsirhani, Alaa Muqbil; Abu-Almakarem, Amal S; Alwaili, Maha Abdullah; Aljohani, Salwa; Alali, Ibtisam; AlRashidi, Aljazi Abdullah; Abuzinadah, Najlaa Yousef; Alkhodair, Sahar Abdulrahman; Mobasher, Maysa A; Alothaim, Tahiyat; Eid, Thamir M; El-Said, Karim Samy
one_liner_zh: 研究丁香提取物缓解大鼠阿霉素肝毒性，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Doxorubicin (DOX), an anticancer drug, is used to treat several types of tumors, but it has detrimental side effects that restrict its therapeutic efficacy. One is the iron-dependent form of ferroptosis, which is characterized by elevated ROS production and iron overload. Syzygium aromaticum has a diverse range of biological and pharmaceutical actions due to their antioxidant properties. This study investigated the effect of S. aromaticum extract (SAE) on hepatotoxicity caused by DOX in rats. Phytochemical analysis was performed to assess compounds in SAE. The ADMETlab 2.0 web server was used to predict the pharmacokinetic properties of the most active components of SAE when DOX was injected into rats. Molecular docking studies were performed using AutoDock Vina. Forty male Sprague Dawley rats were divided into four groups of ten rats each (G1 was a negative control group, G2 was given 1/10 of SAE LD(50) by oral gavage (340 mg/kg), G3 was given 4 mg/kg of DOX intraperitoneally (i.p.) once a week for a month, and G4 was administered DOX as in G3 and SAE as in G2). After a month, biochemical and histopathological investigations were performed. Rats given SAE had promising levels of phytochemicals, which could significantly ameliorate DOX-induced hepatotoxicity by restoring biochemical alterations, mitigating ferroptosis, and upregulating the NRF-2-SLC7A-11-GPX-4 signaling pathway. These findings suggest that SAE could potentially alleviate DOX-induced hepatotoxicity in rats.
abstract_zh: 阿霉素（DOX）是一种抗癌药物，用于治疗多种肿瘤，但其有害副作用限制了其治疗效果。其中之一是铁依赖性铁死亡（ferroptosis），其特征为活性氧（ROS）产生增加和铁过载。丁香（Syzygium aromaticum）因其抗氧化特性而具有多种生物和药理作用。本研究探讨了丁香提取物（SAE）对大鼠中DOX引起的肝毒性的影响。进行了植物化学分析以评估SAE中的化合物。使用ADMETlab 2.0网络服务器预测当DOX注射到大鼠体内时SAE最活性成分的药代动力学特性。分子对接研究使用AutoDock Vina进行。将四十只雄性Sprague Dawley大鼠分为四组，每组十只（G1为阴性对照组，G2通过口服灌胃给予SAE LD(50)的1/10剂量（340 mg/kg），G3每周腹腔注射（i.p.）4 mg/kg DOX一次，持续一个月，G4按G3方式给予DOX并按G2方式给予SAE）。一个月后，进行了生化和组织病理学检查。给予SAE的大鼠显示出有前景的植物化学物质水平，这些物质可通过恢复生化改变、减轻铁死亡并上调NRF-2-SLC7A-11-GPX-4信号通路，显著改善DOX诱导的肝毒性。这些发现表明，SAE可能缓解大鼠中DOX诱导的肝毒性。
